title: Newmark Arranges Sale of Luxury Retail Condominium at 919 North Michigan Avenue in Chicago
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the sale of the 51,795-square-foot retail condominium at 919 North Michigan Avenue along Chicago’s famed Magnificent Mile.
